description: quotaStatus: usage windows ({label, used} with used as a 0..1 ratio) -> {level, label, accountWide} for the account status line, or null when every window is below the warning level. Each window gets quotaLevel(used) (fixtures/quota-level.json: judged on the rounded percent, < 80 normal, 80-99 warning, >= 100 exhausted). A label 'Pool · Window' belongs to that pool; a label without ' · ' belongs to the whole account. A pool takes its worst window. Exhausted wins over warning. Exhausted: an account-wide window -> 'Quota exhausted'; otherwise every exhausted pool in order, joined 'A', 'A and B', 'A, B and C', + ' quota exhausted'. accountWide is true when an account-wide window or every pool is exhausted (the account can serve nothing). Warning: same subject + ' at <max rounded percent of the warning pools>%' ('Quota at 92%', 'Claude & GPT quota at 85%'), accountWide true only for an account-wide window. Clients color the status with the level (warning = amber, exhausted = red) and the chips/bars with quotaLevel per window or pool.
